arxiv-1803-09604.title: A Theorem of Fermat on Congruent Number Curves
arxiv-1803-09604.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by . A positive integer A A is called a congruent number if A A is the area of a right-angled triangle with three rational sides. Equivalently, A A is a congruent number if and only if the congruent number curve y 2 = x 3 − A 2 ​ x y^{2}=x^{3}-A^{2}x has a rational point ( x , y ) ∈ ℚ 2 (x,y)\in\mathds{Q}^{2} with y ≠ 0 y\neq 0 .

arxiv-1903-09146.title: Two’s a crowd? Characterising the effect of photometric contamination on the extraction of the global asteroseismic parameter ν max \nu_{\text{max}} in red-giant binaries
arxiv-1903-09146.creator: S. Sekaran, C. Johnston, A. Tkachenko, P. G. Beck, A. Prša, K. M. Hambleton
arxiv-1903-09146.description: Abstract Context. Theoretical scaling relations for solar-like oscillators and red giants are widely used to estimate fundamental stellar parameters. The accuracy and precision of these relations have often been questioned in the literature, with studies often utilising binarity for model-independent validation.

arxiv-2004-14932.title: Not so presto? Can outer hair cells be sluggish?
arxiv-2004-14932.creator: Kuni H. Iwasa
arxiv-2004-14932.description: Abstract Prestin (SLC26A5), a protein essential for the sensitivity of the mammalian ear, was so named from presto . The assumption was that this membrane protein supports fast movement of outer hair cells (OHCs) that matches the mammalian hearing range, up to 20 kHz in general and beyond, depending on the species.

arxiv-2012-13903.creator: Ankur Chaubey, Manoj K. Jaiswal, Avijit K. Ganguly OPEN a ) a) Institute of Science, Department of Physics, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi- 221005, INDIA

Their appeal also extends to modified theories of gravity, like F ⁡ ( R ) F(R) gravity, Horva Lifshitz gravity etc. In unified theories they make their appearance through compactification of the extra dimension.

arxiv-2207-01926.title: Noncollinear magnetism in two-dimensional CrTe 2 Journal: J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
arxiv-2207-01926.creator: Nihad Abuawwad, Manuel dos Santos Dias, Hazem Abusara, Samir Lounis
arxiv-2207-01926.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nihad Abuawwad, Manuel dos Santos Dias, Hazem Abusara, Samir Lounis. The discovery of two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals magnets opened unprecedented opportunities for the fundamental exploration of magnetism in quantum materials and the realization of next generation spintronic devices. Here, based on a multiscale modelling approach that combines first-principles calculations and a Heisenberg model supplied with ab-initio parameters, we report a strong magnetoelastic coupling in a free-standing monolayer of CrTe 2 .

arxiv-2310-04955.title: Information-Theoretic Bounds on The Removal of Attribute-Specific Bias From Neural Networks
arxiv-2310-04955.creator: Jiazhi Li, Mahyar Khayatkhoei, Jiageng Zhu, Hanchen Xie, Mohamed E. Hussein, Wael AbdAlmageed
arxiv-2310-04955.description: Abstract Ensuring a neural network is not relying on protected attributes ( e.g . , race, sex, age) for predictions is crucial in advancing fair and trustworthy AI. While several promising methods for removing attribute bias in neural networks have been proposed, their limitations remain under-explored.

arxiv-2311-02325.title: Lebesgue property and G G -completeness in generalized quasi-uniform spaces
arxiv-2311-02325.creator: Sugata Adhya and A. Deb Ray
arxiv-2311-02325.description: Abstract . This paper extends the Lebesgue property and (weak) G G -completeness to generalized quasi-uniform spaces. It investigates the connections between completeness, (weak) G G -completeness, and the Lebesgue property of the product of generalized quasi-uniform spaces with those of the component spaces.

arxiv-2404-15193.title: Structurally Flexible Neural Networks: Evolving the Building Blocks for General Agents Conference: Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference; July 14–18, 2024; Melbourne, VIC, Australia Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO ’24), July 14–18, 2024, Melbourne, VIC, Australia DOI
arxiv-2404-15193.creator: Joachim Winther Pedersen, Erwan Plantec, Eleni Nisioti, Milton Montero, Sebastian Risi
arxiv-2404-15193.description: Abstract . Artificial neural networks used for reinforcement learning are structurally rigid, meaning that each optimized parameter of the network is tied to its specific placement in the network structure. Structural rigidity limits the ability to optimize parameters of policies across multiple environments that do not share input and output spaces.

arxiv-2510-19797.creator: Roey Magen Weizmann Institute of Science roey.magen@weizmann.ac.il Gal VardiWeizmann Institute of Science gal.vardi@weizmann.ac.il
arxiv-2510-19797.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Roey Magen Weizmann Institute of Science roey.magen@weizmann.ac.il Gal VardiWeizmann Institute of Science gal.vardi@weizmann.ac.il. arxiv-2602-23383.title: Combinatorial metaplexes and centrality indices for identifying higher-order interactions
arxiv-2602-23383.creator: Hiren J. Dhameliya, Udit Raj, Sudeepto Bhattacharya
arxiv-2602-23383.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hiren J. Dhameliya, Udit Raj, Sudeepto Bhattacharya. Simplicial complexes provide a combinatorial framework for modelling higher-order interactions (HoIs), that is, interactions involving more than two units. In this representation, simplices encode interactions and inclusion relations determine the structural organisation of the system. In classical graph-theoretic and simplicial complex-based models, vertices are treated as structurally homogeneous entities, and their intrinsic properties do not influence the formation of higher-dimensional simplices. However, in many real-world systems, HoIs are influenced by discrete intrinsic properties of the participating units.

pmc-11420202.title: Assessment of doped graphene in the removal of atrazine from water
pmc-11420202.creator: Ahmed Hellal, Hazem Abdelsalam, Walid Tawfik, Medhat A. Ibrahim
pmc-11420202.description: Atrazine is a widely used toxic herbicide that poses a threat to both the environment and human health. This study investigates the removal of Atrazine from water through armchair-hexagonal hexagonal graphene quantum dots (AHEX) simulations. The investigations are performed using density functional theory at the exchange–correlation hybrid functional B3LYP/3-21G level of theory.

pmc-11640769.title: Recognition of mismatched sites in double-stranded DNA by a pair of partially noncomplementary peptide nucleic acids
pmc-11640769.creator: Masanari Shibata, Osami Shoji, Yuichiro Aiba
pmc-11640769.description: We have successfully achieved efficient recognition of mismatched sites in double-stranded DNA through the formation of an invasion complex by using partially noncomplementary peptide nucleic acids (PNAs). pmc-13511412.title: Relative HPV Viral Load Measured by ΔCt for Risk Stratification in Cervical Cancer Screening
pmc-13511412.creator: Morena d’Avenia, Laila Sara Arroyo Mühr, Marcella Mastromauro, Federica Spadaccino, Elisabetta Razzuoli, Michela Iacobellis, Filippo Dell’Anno
pmc-13511412.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryHuman papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer, but most HPV-positive women do not develop clinically significant lesions. Identifying those at higher risk is therefore essential to improve the management of HPV-positive screening results. In this study, we investigated whether the amount of HPV DNA in cervical samples, normalized to cellular content using the routine real-time PCR parameter ΔCt, was associated with the severity of cervical lesions.

pmc-13655260.title: Advancing Biotherapeutic Treatment of Ulcerative Colitis Using Lipid Mesophases: Formulation Design and Preclinical Validation
pmc-13655260.creator: Rafaela Gazzi, Tiziana Cremona, Reto Czekalla, Emily Campbell, Marlene Schwarzfischer, Doris Pöhlmann, Vanessa Dobernig, Gerhard Rogler, Michael Scharl, Alessandra Bergadano, Raffaele Mezzenga, Martin Kuentz, Paola Luciani, Simone Aleandri
pmc-13655260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Biotherapeutics are required to achieve high remission rates in patients with severe ulcerative colitis (UC); however, adverse effects, complex dosing regimens, administration routes, and low patient compliance limit their widespread clinical use. Given the localized nature of UC, this study aimed to develop localized delivery strategies for infliximab (IFX), an anti‐tumor necrosis factor‐α (TNF‐α) monoclonal antibody recommended for moderately‐to‐severely active UC.
